skill.name: context-save
skill.description: Creates a structured Markdown handoff note when the user wants to move work to a new window. It records context, completed work, remaining tasks, key files, notes, and next steps.
skill.summary: Save structured session handoff notes for context continuation.
skill.author: Claudate

security_audit.summary: Static external-command, system-reconnaissance, and obfuscation alerts are false positives from Markdown formatting, examples, and readable Chinese prose. No executable shell, Ruby, network, or reconnaissance behavior was found in SKILL.md. A medium-risk issue remains because session notes may persist sensitive context without redaction guidance.

remediation.issue: Session notes may include secrets or private data.
remediation.suggestion: Add a required redaction step for tokens, credentials, cookies, private URLs, customer data, and personal data before saving.

remediation.issue: Saved context files may be committed with project documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Advise users to review notes before commit, or store sensitive handoff notes in a gitignored location.

content.value_statement: Long Claude and Codex sessions lose critical context when work moves to a new window. This skill creates a structured handoff note that records progress, priorities, key files, and next actions.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes the current session into a structured Markdown handoff note.
Records completed work and unfinished tasks with priority labels.
Lists key files, technical notes, known issues, and next actions.
Uses a consistent filename format for saved session notes.
Places handoff notes under docs/context-sessions for later recovery.
limitations: It relies on the agent view of the current session.
It cannot recover details that were never discussed or visible.
It does not automatically validate file paths or project status.
Users must avoid saving secrets or private data.

use_cases.title: Continue Development in a New Window
use_cases.description: Create a concise handoff note before a long coding session reaches context limits.

use_cases.title: Transfer Project State Across Agents
use_cases.description: Record decisions, unfinished tasks, and important files for another AI assistant session.

use_cases.title: Document Work in Progress
use_cases.description: Capture completed steps, blockers, and next actions while a feature remains unfinished.

prompt_templates.title: Save Basic Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use context-save to summarize this session and save a handoff note for the next window.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner handoff after a short session

prompt_templates.title: Save Prioritized Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Use context-save. Emphasize unfinished work, priority labels, key files, and the first next action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Developer needs a clear restart point

prompt_templates.title: Save Debugging Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use context-save for this debugging session. Include symptoms, attempted fixes, current hypothesis, and files to inspect next.

prompt_templates.title: Save Redacted Project Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use context-save for this complex project. Exclude secrets, tokens, cookies, private URLs, and personal data before saving.

output_examples.input: The user asks to switch windows after implementing login state handling.
output_examples.output: A Markdown handoff note records the completed login work, remaining publish tasks, key files, caveats, and next action.

output_examples.input: The user pauses a debugging session with several unresolved failures.
output_examples.output: A session note lists the current hypothesis, failed attempts, affected files, high priority fixes, and restart guidance.

output_examples.input: The user needs another assistant to continue feature development.
output_examples.output: A structured context file captures project background, decisions, completed steps, pending tasks, and files to review first.

best_practices: Run the skill before context becomes too long to summarize accurately.
Ask for secret redaction when sessions include credentials or customer data.
Review generated file paths and task priorities before relying on the note.
anti_patterns: Do not save API keys, cookies, passwords, tokens, or private customer data.
Do not treat the handoff note as proof that code was tested.
Do not use vague unfinished tasks that lack a clear next action.

faq.question: What trigger does this skill use?
faq.answer: It is designed to run when the user sends the Chinese phrase 换窗口处理-.

faq.question: Where does it save session notes?
faq.answer: It saves Markdown files under docs/context-sessions in the current project.

faq.question: What information does the note include?
faq.answer: It includes context, completed work, unfinished tasks, key files, caveats, and next actions.

faq.question: Does it resume the session automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates a handoff note intended for a separate context-resume workflow.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Claude Code, and Codex support.

faq.question: What should users check before saving?
faq.answer: Users should remove secrets, private data, inaccurate paths, and unclear task descriptions.
